name: Ridge Plot
description: Distributions as smooth density ridges stacked like a mountain range, nearer ridges covering farther ones, with the median and range on hover.

props.name: series
props.type: { label: string; values: number[]; title?: string }[]
props.description: One ridge per entry, top to bottom. label sits on the left; title, when given, heads the tooltip and the table.

props.name: overlap
props.description: How far each ridge rises into the rows behind it, from 0 (none) to 1 (three and a half rows).

props.name: normalize
props.description: Give every ridge the same area so shapes compare regardless of how many values each has. By default ridges are scaled by count, so a busier row stands taller.

props.name: domain
props.description: The range of the shared axis. Defaults to a rounded range around the data, starting at zero when no value is negative.

props.name: bandwidth
props.description: Smoothing width of the density curves, in data units. Defaults to a width chosen per row from its spread and size.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the nearest ridge. Farther ridges fade toward the card.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit written after values and on the last axis tick, e.g. "cm".

props.name: countName
props.description: What each value counts, for the tooltip and table, e.g. "Snow days".

props.name: format
props.description: Writes values in the tooltip and table. Defaults to whole numbers with the unit.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: A title under the horizontal axis. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: yLabel
props.description: A title beside the vertical axis, set sideways. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers. Generated from the data when left out.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: note
props.description: A muted line under the value.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card, e.g. a width. Also accepts delta, action, footer and every other prop of a div.
